description: Sable & Shear is a fictional hair atelier in Singapore: precision cuts, considered colour and balayage from senior stylists. Portfolio demo.

hero.title: Cut with intent.
hero.lead: Precision cuts and considered colour from stylists who listen first. Seniority-tiered, fixed prices. Your colour, considered.

promo.title: 20% off colour services on your first visit.
promo.body: New clients only, any stylist level, until 31 January. Demo offer.

services.title: Precision cut
services.summary: Consultation, wash, cut and finish, shaped around how you wear your hair.

services.title: Root colour
services.summary: Seamless regrowth cover, matched to your existing shade.

services.title: Hand-painted balayage
services.summary: Soft, lived-in colour painted freehand for a slow, graceful grow-out.

services.title: Bridal hair trial
services.summary: A full rehearsal of your wedding-day style, with photos to take home.

pricing.title: Pricing by stylist level
pricing.intro: You choose the level. Every stylist trains in-house; the price reflects experience.

whyUs.title: Seniority-tiered pricing
whyUs.body: Choose your stylist's level up front. The price on the menu is the price you pay.

whyUs.title: Consult first
whyUs.body: Every appointment starts with ten minutes of listening before any scissors come out.

whyUs.title: Considered products
whyUs.body: Professional colour and bond care chosen for Singapore's humidity, never pushed at the till.

testimonials.quote: She asked how I style it on an ordinary Tuesday, then cut for that. Six weeks on, it still falls right.
testimonials.name: Mei L.

testimonials.quote: The price on the menu was exactly what I paid. No surprise add-ons at the counter.
testimonials.name: Hafiz A.

testimonials.quote: My balayage grew out so softly I went four months between visits.
testimonials.name: Clara T.

faqs.question: How do I choose a stylist level?
faqs.answer: Stylists suit most cuts and single-process colour. Seniors and the creative director take complex colour, corrections and bridal. Not sure? Ask on WhatsApp and we'll suggest one.

faqs.question: How far ahead should I book?
faqs.answer: Weekday slots are usually free within a few days. Weekends and senior stylists fill about two weeks ahead.

faqs.question: Do prices include GST?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every price shown includes 9% GST.

faqs.question: What is your cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Reschedule or cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before. After that, we may keep a S$20 late-cancellation fee.

faqs.question: Do I need a strand test before colour?
faqs.answer: For first-time colour with us, yes. It takes ten minutes and can be done on the same day, 48 hours before your appointment.

closing.title: Ready when you are.
closing.body: Book online in under a minute, or message us and a stylist will reply.

footer.blurb: A hair atelier for considered cuts and colour. A fictional demo brand.
